description: Rewrite every engine and platform Coding Rules source in natural American English without creating localized copies. Real Godot rules and stub guidance for other platforms must keep the same technical constraints and installation paths.
acceptance_criteria: Every file under coding-rules-library/engines uses English canonical prose
Godot anti-patterns naming lifecycle signal and resource rules retain their technical meaning
Stub files remain clearly identified as incomplete and actionable
Bootstrap can continue copying the same stable file paths
notes: Human review confirmed all acceptance criteria on 2026-08-26. All six files under coding-rules-library/engines now use English canonical prose at their original paths. The generic, backend, Unity, Unreal, and web-frontend sources remain explicit actionable stubs; Godot remains the complete Godot 4.3+ source. Commit 231ccff restored five categorical rules weakened by the initial translation: immediate return after signal emission, read-only global configuration, mandatory development-time .tres, child-reference-only @onready, and prohibition of set_deferred process_mode for pooled-object deactivation. Bootstrap source and destination copy paths remain stable. Code smell scan: pass (feature: F014, must_fix: 0, suggest: 0, acceptable: 5).
